notice.title: Happy Thanksgiving from the Innioasis Community!
notice.content: Wishing everyone celebrating a warm and restful Thanksgiving. Thank you for being part of the Innioasis community!
notice.full_content:
Wishing everyone celebrating a warm, restful, and happy Thanksgiving!
Thank you to everyone who uses Updater CE, builds themes, contributes to firmware projects, and keeps the Innioasis community thriving. Enjoy the holiday and happy listening!

notice.title: It's the developer's birthday today!
notice.content: Say Happy Birthday with a coffee?
notice.full_content:
[Say Happy Birthday with a coffee?](https://ko-fi.com/teamslide)
Thank you for using Innioasis Updater CE and supporting independent community projects!

notice.title: Merry Christmas & Happy Holidays!
notice.content: Season's greetings from the Innioasis community! Wishing you a joyful Christmas, happy holidays, and a wonderful New Year.
notice.full_content:
Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays from the Innioasis community!
Whether you're relaxing with your favourite playlists or setting up a new Innioasis player for the first time, thank you for being part of this community throughout the year. Wishing you a warm holiday season and a fantastic 2027!
